messages:
Asha (CS): Kicking off an EBR primer for Orion — goal is a tight exec readout + clear asks. Draft agenda: 1) onboarding status 2) usage trends 3) renewal risks 4) enablement asks 5) action items
Tom (Solutions): Add a 90s demo clip showing embedding search vs. baseline. Keep it 2 slides max.
Priya (AE): Heads-up — renewal risk flag: onboarding stalled on SSO and sample dataset import. Customer requested timeline by Friday.
Devon (PM): We can build a sandbox importer. Need sample format from the customer by EOD tomorrow.
Asha (CS): @Devon please confirm ETA so we don't block slides.
Devon (PM): Confirmed — sandbox importer prototype by Thu EOD. Will demo import logs.
Tom (Solutions): I'll own demo slide + short recording. Who can own the usage/health metrics?
Priya (AE): I can pull last-30d active users, API success rate, and top 5 query patterns. Need read access to their prod org.
Asha (CS): Action list (capture for slide footnotes):
- Priya: usage metrics + access request by Wed noon
- Devon: sandbox importer prototype by Thu EOD
- Tom: demo slide + 90s recording by Wed EOD
- Asha: assemble exec one-pager + risks by Fri
Devon (PM): Note: SSO fix is on eng-infra backlog with a tentative patch next sprint. Suggest we include a manual workaround in the deck as mitigation.
Asha (CS): Agreed — include manual workaround steps + ETA, and call out impact (login friction for new seats).
Priya (AE): Capturing customer asks: more granular cost breakdown and a clearer onboarding checklist.
Tom (Solutions): Also include a quick note on the latency spike last month and steps taken (short RCA).
OpsBot: :information_source: QBR deck template v2 uploaded to #docs (link: https://redwood.docs/qbr-template-v2)
Asha (CS): Dry run scheduled Wed 10:00am PT. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've acknowledged your action items.
Priya (AE): :thumbsup:
Devon (PM): :thumbsup:
Tom (Solutions): :thumbsup: 
Asha (CS): Thanks team — I'll send a follow-up with the one-pager draft and calendar invite after I get the metrics.
Priya (AE): Will share metrics + sample screenshots once access is granted.
Devon (PM): I'll ping eng-infra for SSO patch status and loop back in-thread.
Tom (Solutions): Recording note: keep demo without customer data, use synthetic dataset.
Asha (CS): Perfect — closing the thread for now. Will reopen if any slide blockers pop up.
